_note: Example model registry for scripts/run_episode.py. Copy to models.json (gitignored) and edit. These entries reproduce the request settings recorded in the research harness for the five Office actor models in the paper: the core trio (luna, sonnet5, grok45) as used in the original 36-episode bank, and gemini37_flash and glm53 as added for the transfer study. Model availability, serving providers, and prices change over time; prices are USD per million tokens as recorded in August 2026 and drive the cost cap, so check current OpenRouter pricing before a run. temperature null means the parameter is not sent.
